zh: 我正在努力少吃糖。
en: I'm trying to {cut back on|cut down on|ease up on|reduce} sugar.

zh: 那次感冒我花了两个星期才好。
en: It took me two weeks to {get over|shake off|recover from|shake|beat} that cold.

zh: 我觉得我快要得流感了。
en: I think I'm {coming down with|getting|catching} the flu.

zh: 他热得晕倒了，我们叫了救护车。
en: He {passed out|fainted|blacked out|collapsed} in the heat and we called an ambulance.

zh: 她昨晚吐了两次。
en: She {threw up|vomited|was sick} twice last night.

zh: 压力大的时候你要照顾好自己。
en: You need to {look after|take care of} yourself when you're stressed.

zh: 我要去躺半个小时。
en: I'm going to {lie down|rest} for half an hour.

zh: 今天早上我醒来时嗓子疼。
en: I {woke up|woke} with a sore throat this morning.

zh: 我爸十年前戒烟了。
en: My dad {gave up|quit|stopped} smoking ten years ago.

zh: 几天后皮疹就消了。
en: The rash {cleared up|went away|disappeared|went|healed|cleared|faded} after a few days.

zh: 止痛药的药效开始消退了。
en: The painkillers are starting to {wear off}.

zh: 我扭伤后脚踝肿了起来。
en: My ankle {swelled up|swelled|puffed up|blew up|ballooned} after I twisted it.

zh: 我肯定是在办公室染上了什么病菌。
en: I must have {picked up|caught|got|gotten} a bug at the office.

zh: 今天早上有两个人打电话请了病假。
en: Two people {called in|rang in|phoned in} sick this morning.

zh: 连续两年周末加班后，她彻底累垮了。
en: She {burned out|burnt out} after two years of working weekends.

zh: 医生叫我放慢节奏，多睡觉。
en: The doctor told me to {slow down|ease up|ease off|relax|rest|take it easy} and get more sleep.

zh: 我这一整个星期都在跟感冒作斗争。
en: I've been {fighting off|fighting|battling} a cold all week.

zh: 医生叫我彻底戒掉奶制品。
en: My doctor told me to {cut out|give up|avoid|drop|quit} dairy completely.

zh: 我的花粉症一到春天就发作。
en: My hay fever always {flares up|plays up|acts up|gets worse|comes back|returns} in spring.

zh: 周六我睡了个懒觉，感觉好多了。
en: I {slept in|slept late|had a lie-in} on Saturday and felt much better.
